messages:
Iris: Heads up from webinar ops — during last night's webinar we had a big intake burst and ~4% of leads stayed unassigned for >15m. Looks like enrichment blocked RR fallback.
Marco: Oof. Is this the same pattern where we wait for enrichment.score before assigning?
Iris: Yep. HS webhooks create lead -> our enrich pipeline returns 202 async -> assign service gates on score truthiness. Webhook latency + retries = long tails.
Sam: Example logs: 
```
[2026-05-08T22:01:12Z] hs: lead w-998 created
[2026-05-08T22:01:15Z] enrich: webhook accepted 202 id=hook_77
[2026-05-08T22:18:35Z] assign: rr_wait blocking (enrich pending)
```
That one sat 17m.
Priya: For webinars we need a "fastlane" — treat webinar-form leads as high-speed intake: either (A) accept partial enrichment (only required fields) and assign, or (B) fallback to overflow/RR after short TTL.
Jules: Suggestion: two knobs — connector.enrich_ttl_seconds (default 300) and intake.fastlane=true for campaign types. When fastlane=true, reduce TTL to 30s and use minimal enrichment fields for routing.
Marco: Important: avoid duplicate outreach. If we assign before enrichment, tag lead.meta.pre_enrich=true and ensure outreach cadences check that flag and pause automated sequences until enrichment finalizes.
Iris: Also need SF mapping sanity: when enrichment merges later it may alter lead.owner or scoring. We should implement a safe-merge flow: if owner was assigned via fastlane, enrichment update should not reassign unless score delta > threshold + owner not engaged.
Sam: Code sketch for TTL fallback: 
```
if (lead.source === 'webinar' && connector.fastlane) {
  ttl = Math.min(connector.enrich_ttl_seconds || 300, 30)
} else {
  ttl = connector.enrich_ttl_seconds || 300
}
if (lead.enrich_status === 'pending' && now - lead.enrich_started_at > ttl) {
  assignRoundRobin(lead)
  lead.meta.push('pre_enrich_assigned')
}
```
Priya: Telemetry: counter(pre_enrich_assigned), counter(post_enrich_merge_reassign), and metric duplicate_outreach_incidents. Alert if pre_enrich_assigned / daily_inbound > 1% or duplicate_outreach_incidents > 5/day.
Jules: UX: add a toggle in HubSpot connector mapping UI for "fastlane sources" so marketing can mark webinar forms without config deploys. Also allow per-market TTL override (EMEA slower => longer).
Marco: Canary plan: roll fastlane to 5% of webinar leads for 48h. Verbose logs and add a temporary audit table to track pre_enrich assignments and later merges. Auto-rollback if duplicate_outreach_incidents > 0.05% or median time-to-first-contact worsens.
Iris: SDR playbook: when seeing lead.meta.pre_enrich_assigned, use script "Intro (fastlane)" and note: wait for enrichment result before making second outreach. We'll add a Playground check in the sales UI to show enrichment status.
Sam: Tests: unit for TTL math, integration test where enrichment returns late, and e2e that simulates webinar spike. Also ensure VIP accounts bypass fastlane.
Priya: I'll draft the Grafana dashboard queries and alert thresholds.
leadflow-bot: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/leadflow/pulls/1810 -> staging -> canary-5% -> prod. Canary ticket #LF-2026.
Jules: Action items: Marco -> PR for TTL + fastlane flag, Sam -> tests + SF merge rules, Priya -> metrics + dashboard, Iris -> SDR playbook language, I'll update connector UI mock. Sync tomorrow 8:30am PT. :calendar:
